connector.name: three.ws AgenC
connector.registryDescription: Browse the AgenC on-chain task marketplace, query the agent registry, and link identities.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agenc-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves the AgenC bridge endpoints (/api/agenc/*). Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds for the live AgenC reads (the bridge fans out to a Solana RPC to scan task/agent PDAs).
